text_description: A layered pastel-and-red look shown from upper thigh to head: a pale mint cropped jacket sits open over a vivid coral-red button-front shirt. The jacket has a broad pointed red collar, relaxed long sleeves, a boxy waist-length silhouette, and burgundy trim accents including small horizontal welt-like details on the chest and front panels, plus burgundy bow-and-scroll motifs near the hem. Underneath, the red shirt is longer and loose, extending well below the jacket with an untucked shirttail hem; it has a soft open collar, visible gold-tone buttons down the center, and dark burgundy vertical striping or edging running along the placket and side areas. The lower garment appears to match the jacket in pale mint, visible as a skirt or shorts panel at the bottom of the frame, decorated with the same burgundy bow motif and bordered striping, with narrow hanging side ties or ribbon-like strips in mint and burgundy. Styling includes a chunky gold chain necklace and small hoop/drop earrings, reinforcing an ornate, slightly retro coordinated-set mood with strong contrast between mint, coral red, and burgundy.
